rooms.name: The Overseer's Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is where Nevyn watches the events that happen in the Grey Keep. It is a
large room, with a bed, a bookshelf, a desk, a couple chairs, and a decorative
shield hanging on the wall with the sigil of Gil-Glash upon it.

rooms.name: Before a Great Wall
rooms.desc:
Looming before you is a tall wall made out of some dark mineral which you
cannot identify. The wall is somehow melded into the mountain to the west of
you, making it more solid and giving more protection in case what the wall is
guarding is ever under siege.

rooms.name: Before a Massive Gate
rooms.desc:
Standing before you is the biggest gate you've ever seen, wide enough to let
three wagons through side by side and tall enough for the tallest of giants to
walk through while holding his head high.  Unfortunately, the gates appear to
be made of the same solid stone as the mountains which surround them, and you
can see no way of opening them.

rooms.name: Before a Great Wall
rooms.desc:
Looming before you is a tall wall made out of some dark mineral which you
cannot identify. The wall is somehow melded into the mountain to the east of
you, making it more solid and giving more protection in case what the wall is
protecting is ever under siege.

rooms.name: Inside the Wall
rooms.desc:
This side of the wall faces a huge castle that spans the whole width of the
valley and is probably wider and deeper than you can imagine. The side of the
mountain to the west has been worked smooth and radiates a strong aura of
protection magicks. High green grass grows here, strangly, without weeds.

rooms.name: Inside the Gate
rooms.desc:
This side of the huge gate to your south faces what looks like the front of
a remarkably giant castle made out of grey stone.  The gate itself is made
of solid stone and looks unopenable.  You are presently standing on a grassy
patch of land that appears to rim the castle wall to the east and west.

rooms.name: Inside the Wall
rooms.desc:
This side of the wall faces a huge castle that spans the whole width of the
valley and is probably wider and deeper than you can fathom. The side of the
mountain to the east has been worked smooth and radiates a strong aura of
protection magicks. The grass here is a vibrant green and grows up to your
knees.

rooms.name: Before the Castle
rooms.desc:
The castle wall before you is made up of a strange grey material, which gives
it an oddly forbidding appearance. Thin arrow slits line the wall to the north
and the side of the mountain to the west has been worked smooth. As you look
up you are amazed at how tall the castle is, although it is not nearly as tall
as the wall slightly to your south. Green, knee-high grass rubs against you
as you move around.

rooms.name: At the Entrance to the Castle
rooms.desc:
A couple wide steps lead up to a big set of wooden double doors that are bound
in black iron. The walls to the east and west of the doors are lined with thin
arrow slits in case of attackers. The grass here is a bright green and is not
worn down much, this place must not get many visitors.

rooms.name: Before the Castle
rooms.desc:
The castle wall before you is made up of a strange grey material, which gives
it an oddly forboding appearance. Thin arrow slits line the wall to the north
and the side of the mountain to the east has been worked smooth. As you look
up you are amazed at how tall the castle is, although not nearly as tall as the
wall to the south. Not much grass grows here, and the grass that does grow is
small and not as green as the rest of the field.

rooms.name: The Foyer
rooms.desc:
As you walk into the foyer of the huge castle, balls of light that have been
inset into the east and west walls light up, dispersing all shadows from the
room. The room is unfurnished and a tall, thin door is on the east wall. To
the north is a great hall and to the south is a set of thick, wooden double
doors.

rooms.name: A Great Hall
rooms.desc:
You are in a huge room, exits lie in all directions. Silken tapestries line the
walls depicting great battles throughout history. Hanging from the high ceiling
is a huge crystal chandelier which seems to illuminate the entire room, even
the corners. A beautiful red carpet leads off to the north.

rooms.name: The Ante Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room has been furnished beautifully, which is odd compared to the rest of
the keep. Banners and flags hang from the walls and a thick, red carpet runs
from the hall in the south to the room north of here. Balls of light the size
of your head have been inset into the walls.

rooms.name: The Throne Room
rooms.desc:
An enormous room opens before you, stretching well over a hundred feet to the
other end. The ceiling is higher than all but the tallest trees. The walls and
ceiling are layered in hammered gold, finely filigreed and delicately painted.
Rich silk tapestries hang from the walls. The far end of the room appears to be
one huge, red velvet curtain. Centered against the backdrop of the curtain is
a monolithic throne. The chair itself sits atop a raised, stepped stage as tall
as a man. The throne itself is sized to seat a giant, not a man. It is worked
in silver and inlaid with sapphires and emeralds.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in part of a long hallway, a door is in the north wall to the east of
you. The hallway is lighted, but not enough so that you can see everything,
and something might be hiding in the shadows.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
You're in a long hallway that goes east and west. It is lighted here but not
bright enough so that something couldn't sneak by you in the shadows. There
is a thick, iron door to the north.

rooms.name: The Smithy
rooms.desc:
You've entered a huge room filled with all the necessary tools a blacksmith
would need to make a suit of armor. A forge is burning in the north-west corner
and shelves on the east and south walls have all sorts of ingots and rods on
them.

rooms.name: An Intersection
rooms.desc:
This is where the hallway splits into different directions, you can go west,
towards the entrance of the keep, east to what seems to be a large spiral
staircase, north to another hall, and there's a door in the south wall. This
room is well lit, but not enough so all the shadows are banished.

rooms.name: Weapon Storage
rooms.desc:
This room is filled with all sorts of weapons, from awl pikes to zweihanders,
you're sure you could find any weapon ever heard of here. Steel chests and
wooden crates are in the back of the room, surely holding other weapons. There
are doors to the north and south.

rooms.name: Armor Storage
rooms.desc:
In contrast to the room north of here, this room is filled with all sorts of
armor, from the antali warrior's hard pelts to the Grey Keep's own suits of
grey armor. Each set of armor is equipped by wood carved into shapes of
the different races of the land, some familiar like Ssaurs, others you've
never even imagined existing.

rooms.name: On a Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
You have reached a spiral staircase, from here you can go west towards the
great hall, or down into the darkness. The staircase isn't lighted well and
seems kind of dangerous.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway runs north and south, and there is a door set into the east wall.
A bright beam of light shoots out of the crack between the bottom of the door
and the floor, dispersing the shadows.

rooms.name: Nimos' Chamber
rooms.desc:
Nimos didn't need much room, so unlike some of Gil-Glash's other generals, he
only asked for one small chamber without servants. The room is more like a
cluttered attic than the abode of a powerful warlock. All sorts of books and
scrolls litter the floor of the room, even the bed is partially covered with
papers. Shelves, bolted into the stone walls, line every wall but the north
one, which is dominated by a massive stone bookshelf which happens to be the
most organized part of the room. A large mirror stands in the south-east
corner, reflecting everything in the room at you.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This part of the hallway is lighted, but not so much that something couldn't
sneak by you unnoticed. There are doors on the east wall to the north and to
the south.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway is much like the rest of the other hallways in the keep, there's
enough light to see but not enough so that things can't hide in the shadows.
There is a door in the east wall.

rooms.name: Entrance to Lady Amber's Quarters
rooms.desc:
This is a large room that is mainly empty, except for benches along the north
and south walls, and plants in the corners. There are doors on the east and
west walls.

rooms.name: The Hall of Crossed Swords
rooms.desc:
This is the room that Lady Amber trains her fighting skills in, and where she
has duels with other swordspeople. All swords of sword hang on every wall.
Weights and conditioning aids are ocver in the corner of the large room, and
next to them are diagrams of the anatomy of various races and charts showing
different weapons and schematics teaching positioning during battle.

rooms.name: Lady Amber's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This room seems to be totally unlike the serious, battle-hardened Lady Amber.
A huge, four poster bed dominates most of the room, and a window to the east
looks out over a beautiful landscape. A closet in the west wall is where she
must store her clothing, and on the wall next to the closet is a huge square
of silvered glass.

rooms.name: The Secret Room
rooms.desc:
This large room is strangely hotter than most of the other rooms in the keep,
and a big bed is pushed up against the northern wall. On the west wall are
all sorts of strange objects, some look like they're used to cause pain, and
others look like they're meant to cause pleasure.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway seems a bit brighter than all the others. A dark red banner is
hanging from the north wall. The hallway goes west and south.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, gloomy hallway that leads east and west. A dim sphere of
light is inset into the northern wall here, giving the room the little amount
of light it has.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hall is much like the other halls in the keep, except that to the west
and north the hallway opens up to a large chamber. From here you can go east
or west.

rooms.name: A Large Chamber
rooms.desc:
The large room you are in opens up to a great dining hall to the north, the
dining hall is brightly lit and this room has no shadows. The hallway leads
west and east from here.

rooms.name: The Dining Hall
rooms.desc:
This huge room is lit up brightly by a great crystal chandelier that hovers
high above the table, but doesn't touch the tall ceiling. There is a large
black marble table, with crimson veins, in the center of the room. At the head
of the table, on the northern side of the room, is Gil-Glash's towering seat.
On each side of the table are three smaller seats, all made of a different
material. On the end of the table a comfortable, but small, chair rests. There
is a wide door in the eastern wall.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This long, narrow room contains the mixed scents of all sorts of food
products. A long counter stretches the length of the north wall. On the east
side of the room is a huge metal door with a big lock on it.

rooms.name: The Meat Locker
rooms.desc:
This room is freezing! Frost covers all of the walls and the floor is slick
with a thin layer of ice. Small icicles hang down all over the ceiling along
with big, sharp hooks that hold up carcasses of herd beasts. Near the back of
the room, you see many, more familiar, shapes hanging from hooks.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hall is a lot like the other halls in the keep, but to the north-east the
hallway opens up into a large chamber, from which light spills out, brightening
this part of the hall. From here you can go east or west.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This part of the hallway is dark, but once your eyes get accustomed to the
blackness, you can tell that to the west the hall ends and turns south.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway seems a little bit brighter than some of the other hallways. A
dark, navy blue banner hangs from the north wall. From here you can go south
and east.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This part of the hallway does not have much light in it. A large, dim sphere
has been placed into the ceiling. There is a door in the western wall.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a long, dark hallway. There is enough light to show you where you
are going, but not enough so that something couldn't sneak by in the shadows.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway is lighted fairly well. To the south you can see that the hallway
splits off into two other directions. On the west wall here is a door.

rooms.name: An Intersection
rooms.desc:
From here you can go in four directions. To the north, deeper into the keep,
east, back towards the entrance to the keep. West, towards a spiral staircase,
or you can enter the door to the south.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark hallway. An indescribable smell emanates from under the door
in the northern wall.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hall is illuminated by a light from the big room that opens up to the east
of here. From here you can go deeper into the keep by going west, back towards
the entrance by going east, or south into the Grey Slayer's barracks.

rooms.name: A Strange Laboratory
rooms.desc:
This large room is divided into several sections and is filled with shelves and
long tables. You can't see any chairs in the whole room. The shelves contain
books, liquids of varying colors, strange sculptures, stuffed animals, jars of
live insects, worms, lizards, reams of blank parchment, glassware of all shapes
and sizes and so on.

rooms.name: The Vestibule
rooms.desc:
This small room has benches lined against the north and south wall. To the
west, the room seems to open up into a big chamber, but you can't tell what's
in it. You can tell that this room is lit by some magickal force, but you
can't see anything that could be a light source.

rooms.name: The Receiving Room
rooms.desc:
This is where Hisczdrezzez receives all his visitors, he only lets his most
trusted allies and servants go into the rooms to the north, south and west. Only
Gil-Glash can walk around the yuan-ti's rooms without permission, though he 
respects Hisczdrezzez's privacy and would only go through his rooms in a dire
emergency. A strangely-made throne sits on the west side of the room, in front
of a large, red divan.

rooms.name: A Sunken Chamber
rooms.desc:
The floor to this chamber is sunken, and covered with pillows of all sizes,
making it look like a giant bed. Intricate tapestries line the walls, 
displaying great events in the history of the yuan-ti race, and some show
other, more reptilian beings being worshipped by the now almost extinct group.

rooms.name: The Shrine
rooms.desc:
This is Hisczdrezzez's sacred shrine to the snake goddess that once spawned
the yuan-ti race. He lets no one enter this room, and only Gil-Glash if he
specifically demands it. There is a huge, jade statue against the western wall,
in front of a shallow dip in the center of the floor. There is an inscription
near the bottom of the statue.

rooms.name: Hisczdrezzez's Armory
rooms.desc:
This room is lined with wooden weapon racks holding many strange-looking
weapons. In the back of the room is one even stranger suit of armor that
appears to be hovering in mid-air. This is Hisczdrezzez's private armory,
where he keeps the weapons sacred to his race and worshippers of his goddess.
Most of the weapons radiate an aura of danger, and the armors of protection.

rooms.name: The Questioning Room
rooms.desc:
This stone room is barren of all furniture, except for a long, wooden table
with several chips taken out of it and blood stains all over. This is where the
alhoon Alhazred interrogates prisoners and spies. Shackles hang every five feet
on the walls, and, judging from the dried blood that drenches the walls, they
were used quite recently.

rooms.name: Alhazred's Private Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is where the alhoon rests and thinks up plans for the future. A very
comfortable-looking bed is in the south-west side of the room, opposite a
stainless steel tub in the south-east side, it seems to be filled with a thick,
pink liquid. Burnt into the stone floor is a large, circle covered with all
sorts of arcane letters and runes. Next to the door is a big, stone bookshelf.

rooms.name: The Anteroom
rooms.desc:
This is the entryway to Raithir's rooms, it is draped in black and dark crimson
tapestries and there are comfortable looking benches against the north and
south walls. Small ceramic pots with different types of mushrooms growing from
them are in the four corners of the room. From here you can go through either
the door to the east and back to the hallway, or the door to the west and into
the rest of Raithir's chambers.

rooms.name: Raithir's Office
rooms.desc:
This room is Raithir's so-called 'office' from which he has audience with the
others who call the Grey Keep home. There is a huge, black marble desk that is
covered in all sorts of documents that look important. The only light in this
room comes from the glowing fungi that dot the walls. There are doors on the
east, south and north walls.

rooms.name: Raithir's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This is where Raithir spends his nights when not skulking around the keep. Most
of the room is dominated by a large, black bed with silken sheets. A small
nightstand is sitting next to the bed, and on the nightstand is a small pillar
that illuminates the room. A big stone bookshelf has been placed against the
eastern wall.

rooms.name: Raithir's Treasury
rooms.desc:
This is where Raithir keeps all the gold and magical items he's 'acquired' in
his travels, and it is truly a magnificent sight to behold. Large mounds of
gold, silver, and foreign coins are scattered around the floor. Wands, staves
and other items occasionally protrude from the piles.

rooms.name: The Grey Slayer's Barracks
rooms.desc:
This is where some of the Grey Slayers sleep when not on duty. It is a long
room lined with old cots. At the foot of each cot is a trunk in which the
belongings of the Grey Slayer is kept. A small, glowing sphere is inset into
the wall over the headboard of each bed.

rooms.name: At the Top of a Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
You have reached a massive, spiraling staircase which isn't lighted well and
seems a little dangerous. From here you can go east towards the great hall or
down into the darkness.

rooms.name: On a Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
You are on a massive spiral staircase. The only directions you can go from here
are up, towards the ground level, or down, deeper into the bowels of the earth.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of a Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
You are at the bottom of the dark, gloomy staircase. There is no light source
here and it isn't very bright. To the east is a large, open room.

rooms.name: The Entrance to the First Dungeon
rooms.desc:
This room is not furnished at all except for a tiny stool. This is the room
that everything must go through to move between the first dungeon and the rest
of the Keep. There is a huge steel door on the east wall.

rooms.name: In the First Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You are in a long corridor lined with doors. There is not much light here, but
there is enough for you to tell the doors were made to keep things inside,
permanently. There is a huge steel door on the western wall.

rooms.name: In the First Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You are in a long, dark corridor lined with doors. There are doors to the east
and west of you, thick wooden doors with little hatches through which you can
see the prisoner inside.

rooms.name: In the First Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You have reached the end of a long, dark corridor. There are doors to the east
and west of you. The doors are thick and wooden and have little holes about
five and a half feet from the bottom of the door through which you can see
what is happening inside.

rooms.name: In the First Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You are in a long, dark corridor. There is a thick, metal door on the east and
west walls. There are small hatches in the bottom of the door where the
prisoner inside is fed from.

rooms.name: In the First Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of a long, dark corridor. On the east and west walls are
thick, steel doors which are covered in all sorts of arcane runes.

rooms.name: Amaristee's Cell
rooms.desc:
This room is a filthy mess, feces and other wastes are piled into a corner and
are being dug through by all sorts of vermin. The only light in this room comes
from whenever the door, or the hatch on the door, is open, and even then only
a little light is spread into the vermin-ridden chamber.

rooms.name: Yathruin's Cell
rooms.desc:
This dirty room smells like it hasn't been cleaned since it was built. Piles
of dirt, feces, and other refuse dot the floor. There is no light here, and
the only light that ever touches this chamber is when the door is opened to
allow food to the cell's occupant.

rooms.name: An Empty Cell
rooms.desc:
This room has been scrubbed clean, although you still notice some marks left
by the last occupant of the cell. Trash and debris is still stuck in the
corners of the room, but otherwise it doesn't look like it would be too bad to
live here, of course only if you were fed well and could walk in and out
whenever you wished.

rooms.name: Rilithinn's Cell
rooms.desc:
This cell is cleaner than some of the others, because it's current owner has
moved in just recently. The room is still dark, and the only light comes from
when the door is opened or the hole in the door uncovered.

rooms.name: Aldegund's Cell
rooms.desc:
This room is smaller than most of the other cells you've seen so far, giving
barely enough room to sleep and almost none to stand. It is dark in here, but
because of your light you can see the small pile of feces and other refuse that
seems to be used as a pillow.

rooms.name: Ratharr's Cell
rooms.desc:
This cell is so compact that you have to hunch over and breath in deeply to
enter, whoever the occupant is must not be a very happy being. With the door
closed, this room would be completely black, but it wouldn't matter much, since
there's nothing to see anyways.

rooms.name: Belaerzyn's Cell
rooms.desc:
This large cell is basically empty, and seems like it is cleaned every day. On
the middle of the floor is a large, round pentagram which seems to have been
drawn in blood, and is slowly flaking away. The room is as dark as the others,
and is only illuminated when the door is open.

rooms.name: An Empty Cell
rooms.desc:
This room looks like it hasn't been used in a long while, a carpet of dust at
least half an inch thick covers the floor, and through it you can barely see
the outline of what used to be a pentagram in the middle of the floor.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of a Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
You are at the bottom of the massive spiral staircase, it is still dark, but
some light emanates from a room that opens up to the west. You can either go
up the spiral staircase or west, into the bright room.

rooms.name: The Entrance to the Second Dungeon
rooms.desc:
This large, room is illuminated by half a dozen glowing spheres that hover in
a circle formation near the ceiling. There is a chair and desk against the
north wall and a thick, black door against the west wall.

rooms.name: In the Second Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You are in a long, bright corridor. The thick stone walls are lined with thick,
metal doors. The source of the light is the round, glowing sphere above each
set of doors.

rooms.name: In the Second Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You are in a long, bright corridor. Doors line the walls and to the north and
south are two thick metal ones. The door on the southern wall looks like the
thing on the other side has tried to break out more than once.

rooms.name: In the Second Dungeon
rooms.desc:
This part of the long, bright corridor is the same as the others. There are
two thick, steel doors here, one on the north wall and one on the south.

rooms.name: In the Second Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You have reached the end of the long, bright corridor, there are three thick,
steel doors here, one on the north wall, one on the south, and one on the west.

rooms.name: A Large Cell
rooms.desc:
The walls of this cell have magickal runes carved straight into the stone on
them. The runes are now dull and don't seem to be doing anything. This room
must be very dark when the door is closed, for you cannot see any source of
light.

rooms.name: A Large Cell
rooms.desc:
The walls of this chamber are covered in magickal runes that glow with an
unearthly aura. The room seems devoid of all life and you feel the life slowly
being drained from your soul.

rooms.name: A Large Cell
rooms.desc:
The walls of this room are engraved with all sorts of magickal runes and
glyphs. A small pool of water lies in the northeast corner of the room, slowly
becoming stagnant. Aside from the glowing runes, there is no light source in
this room and it is very dark.

rooms.name: A Large Cell
rooms.desc:
Glowing runes and glyphs are engraved on each stone that make up the walls of
this cell. Aside from that, there is no light in the room and it is a very
gloomy place to be. A small pool of water is in the northwest corner of the
room, and the rotting carcass of what must be a cow is in the southwest corner.

rooms.name: A Huge Cell
rooms.desc:
This cell is amazingly huge, you can't imagine how many stones make up the
walls, ceiling, and floor of this room, and wouldn't even fathom the amount of
individual runes and glyphs on each of them. A large pool of water is in the
northwest part of the cell, which is more like a cavern.

rooms.name: A Small Cell
rooms.desc:
This cell is big enough to house a man, albeit uncomfortably. A small puddle of
water is in the southeast corner of the chamber and the remains of what seem to
be fish. Maggots crawl over the remaining carrion.

rooms.name: A Small Cell
rooms.desc:
The walls of this small room are covered with arcane glyphs of all kinds. Now
they are dull, instead of glowing lightly like the ones in the other cells. The
room is empty and looks like it's been cleaned often.

rooms.name: A Large Cell
rooms.desc:
You are in a large cell, the only light comes from the glowing runes and glyphs
that cover the walls. A small pool of brackish water lies in the southwest
corner of the cell. The inside of the door to the north has many dents and
scratches, the most recent occupant of this room must have wanted out.

rooms.name: A Large Cell
rooms.desc:
The walls of this cell are covered in runes and glyphs that glow. Their light
shines through the scorched marks that have been burnt into the walls, it seems
that whoever is this cell's occupant had some control over fire that wasn't
just magickal.

rooms.name: Gil-Glash's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This room has been lavishly decorated. A massive bed takes up a majority of the
space here. Aside from the doors to the west and north, the walls are covered
in bookshelves. You can see a large summoning circle that has been etched into
the floor, but it is partially covered by the bed.

rooms.name: Gil-Glash's Harem
rooms.desc:
The floor of this room is covered with silken pillows and sheets. This is where
Gil-Glash releases his stress and he comes here sometimes when he is frustrated
enough so that he cannot concentrate.

rooms.name: In a Narrow Valley
rooms.desc:
You are in a narrow valley, wide enough for a small wagon to pass through with
ease. To the east lie the foothills of the dor-Sefrith plains and the valley
continues running to the west.

rooms.name: In a Narrow Valley
rooms.desc:
You are in a narrow valley in the Grey Mountains, the valley curves towards the
north from here, where the valley seems to open up. To the east the valley
continues.

rooms.name: Before a Wide, Open Valley
rooms.desc:
You are at a part in the valley where it opens up into a large, cavern-like
space. Strangely enough, a huge black wall blocks your view to the end of the
valley.

rooms.name: A Chamber of Glass
rooms.desc:
The walls of this round room are made from thick glass, you don't think you
could break through it. The ceiling is the only part not made of glass, it seems
to be some sort of wood with many holes. You cannot see any exit, but through
the glass many things seem to be going on, but it is too blurry to tell.

rooms.name: A Strange Cell
rooms.desc:
This room is strange, the walls are invisible and all you can see behind them
is white, cloudy space, like you're on some other plane. Occasionally you see
dark patches move rapidly by your prison, nothing slow or close enough to let
you make out the forms. The cell is big enough to let you move around, but you
get the feeling that you won't need to move around for a long while.

rooms.name: The Sewer
rooms.desc:
This large room is filled with garbage. Holes in the ceiling that reach up to
most of the individual rooms are where the garbage and other, more aromatic,
refuse comes from.
